hints: Check your total monthly income vs your recurring expenses in the ledger. Are you making enough to cover everything?
Make sure you route exactly what is needed to your Fixed expenses first.
If your checking account is dropping below zero, change your flexible expense (Food, Entertainment) routings from fixed dollars ($) to percentages (%) to only spend what remains.

client.name: Alex
client.description: Alex just got their first apartment and wants to make sure they aren't spending more than they make.
client.prompt: I don't know why my checking account is dropping! My rent is fixed, but I might be spending too much on going out.
